## Project Structure Summary

### Directory Structure
- **`src/layouts/`** - Base layout files (`Layout.astro`, `Article.astro`)
- **`src/pages/`** - Route pages (`index.astro`, dynamic routes for `/fix`, `/maintain`, `/buy`)
- **`src/components/mdx/`** - Custom MDX components for automotive content
- **`src/content/articles/`** - MDX article content
- **`src/data/`** - YAML data files (authors, categories, topics, vehicles)

### Site Name/Branding Configuration

**Primary branding location:**
- **`src/layouts/Layout.astro`** (line 11): `const siteTitle = "The Driveway Mechanic";`
  - Used in:
    - Page titles (line 15)
    - Header logo (line 73)
    - Footer branding (line 141)
    - Copyright notice (line 182)
    - Open Graph meta tags (line 37)

**Other branding references:**
- **`package.json`**: 
  - `name: "driveway-mechanic"`
  - `description: "The Driveway Mechanic - automotive DIY and maintenance content site..."`
- **`astro.config.mjs`**: `site: "https://drivewaymechanicguide.com"`
- **`src/pages/index.astro`**: Uses "The Driveway Mechanic" in hero section
- **`src/data/authors/driveway-mechanic-team.yaml`**: Author name is "The Driveway Mechanic Team"
- **`README.md`**: Title and description reference "The Driveway Mechanic"

### Findings

- No references to "Elaren" or "Elaren Studio" found in the codebase
- All branding points to "The Driveway Mechanic"
- Tagline: "Fix it yourself. Save hundreds." (defined in `Layout.astro` line 12)

If the deployed site shows "Elaren Studio", possible causes:
1. Different deployment/branch
2. Environment variables overriding branding
3. Cached build artifacts
4. Content served from an external source

To change branding, update `siteTitle` in `src/layouts/Layout.astro` (line 11) and the tagline (line 12).
